C2.for_what_part: Only the staged set is shown: 100 cases added and 100 accounts holding the fixed status value. The live tables are not read.

C4.for_what_part: Only the staged set is shown: no table, column or row beyond those the agreement names, and no deletion. The live tables are not read.

C7.for_what_part: The rehearsal runs on a copy of the live tables and shows that the undo restores the state before the promotion. It does not show that the worker kept the staged working copies.

C8.for_what_part: It shows that the recipients equal those promoted and the wording equals the approved wording, and gives the number to send. It does not show that orders were placed, since the orders come after the release.

C9.for_what_part: It shows the sending calls confirmed and those ordered and not confirmed, with the fingerprints of their recipients and wording against the release. A customer with two calls will have to be checked in the record itself.

plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: Instruments that read the live tables: no instrument reads them for the category rule (C3) or for the promoted state (C1, C2, C4). The price limit rules out adding same set or summary of the change at A2 and A3, and the undo rehearsal at A3.
